from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v != 0)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    foregrounds = {v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0, background)}
    if not foregrounds:
        return g
    fg = max(foregrounds, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    cells = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == fg}
    start = next(iter(cells))
    comp = {start}
    q = deque([start])
    while q:
        r, c = q.popleft()
        for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
            for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
                p = (r + dr, c + dc)
                if p in cells and p not in comp:
                    comp.add(p)
                    q.append(p)
    minr = min(r for r, c in comp)
    minc = min(c for r, c in comp)
    shape = {(r-minr, c-minc) for r, c in comp}
    # Search the original grid so newly painted copies cannot seed further copies.
    for r0 in range(h - max(r for r, c in shape)):
        for c0 in range(w - max(c for r, c in shape)):
            if all(g[r0+r][c0+c] == background for r, c in shape):
                if any(g[r0+r][c0+c] == fg for r, c in shape):
                    continue
                for r, c in shape:
                    g[r0+r][c0+c] = fg
    return g
PY
